name: Northflank
tagline: Deploy apps, databases, and AI/GPU workloads on any cloud.
description: Northflank is a developer platform for deploying applications, databases, jobs, and AI/GPU workloads from Git to production. It abstracts away Kubernetes and runs on Northflank's managed cloud or in your own AWS, GCP, Azure, or bare-metal account (BYOC), billed by the second. Teams like Writer, Sentry, and Chai Discovery run on it.
insight: Founded in London in 2019 by two engineers who met in a multiplayer game; raised $22.3M in 2024 led by Bain Capital Ventures.

modelSupport.notes: Runs any container or model on managed or your own GPUs.

edge: One platform for apps and AI/GPU workloads, run on Northflank's cloud or your own AWS/GCP/Azure/bare-metal account (BYOC).
pros: Apps, databases, jobs & GPUs in one platform
Per-second billing, no idle GPU charges
Used by Writer, Sentry, Chai Discovery
cons: Breadth can mean a learning curve
Pay-as-you-go costs need monitoring at scale

references.title: Northflank secures $22.3 million for its developer workload platform
